description: A gray plastic tub with ice cubes sits on the table next to a small yellow cup, and a purple scoop rests to the right. The right hand picks up the purple scoop and dips it into the tub to gather ice, while the left hand steadies the tub and then reaches to hold the yellow cup; the right hand lifts the scoop over the cup and tilts it to dump the ice in, then pulls the scoop away.
